blocks.content: An administrator must enable Agent Observability for your stack. Sign in to Grafana Cloud as an administrator before you start; Grafana Admins have the Agent Observability Admin role by default.
Open Agent Observability, accept the terms, and confirm the sidebar entry.
Navigate to **Observability** > **Agent Observability**. The menu entry may be labelled **Agent**.
Review and accept the terms, then click **Save**.
blocks.hint: Don't see a terms screen or **Save**? Agent Observability is already enabled on this stack. Skip this step.

blocks.content: Confirm that **Agent Observability** now appears under **Observability** in the left sidebar.
Agent Observability is enabled on your stack. The `sigil:write` scope you select in Milestone 3 is available in the access policy dropdown from now on.
Continue straight to the next milestone to copy the two values the SDK needs from Agent Observability.
